paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's messenger, Jō Izumi-no-kami Nobushige, first arrived at the camp of Ikeda Tadatsugu of Okayama. Both Ikeda Tadatsugu and Ikeda Toshitaka of Himeji were sons of Sanzaemon Terumasa. Toshitaka was the elder and Tadatsugu the younger; even before moving their camps here, the brothers had quarreled over who would lead the vanguard.

units.source_en: Had the fog not been dense and the weather bitterly cold, Katō Akinari's force would never have considered crossing the river.

ja.t: えることはなかっただろう。

units.source_zh: 设若雾气不浓，天气不寒，加藤明成部自不会考虑渡河。

units.source_en: Even under these conditions, had Jō Izumi-no-kami not come, Akinari probably would not have accepted at once the proposal of his veteran retainer Tsukuda Jirōbei, but would have delayed still longer.
units.source_zh: 在此条件下，若城和泉守不来，他怕还不会立刻采信老臣佃治郎兵卫的建议，还要往后拖呢。

units.source_en: Yet because they mistook the man sent by Ieyasu for someone coming to offer encouragement, they immediately put the river crossing into action.
units.source_zh: 然，由于他们把家康派人看成前来慰问，方立时采取渡河行动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 设若雾气不浓，天气不寒，加藤明成部自不会考虑渡河。在此条件下，若城和泉守不来，他怕还不会立刻采信老臣佃治郎兵卫的建议，还要往后拖呢。然，由于他们把家康派人看成前来慰问，方立时采取渡河行动。

paragraphs.source_en: In a herd of horses long held in check, once one breaks into a run, all the others will race desperately after it. Besides, the Ikeda brothers had long been straining to bolt. Jō Izumi-no-kami arrived at just the right moment, and the horses broke free of their reins.

units.source_en: In a herd of horses long held in check, once one breaks into a run, all the others will race desperately after it.
units.source_zh: 压抑已久的马群，只要有一匹率先冲出，其余的自会拼命跟上。

units.source_en: Besides, the Ikeda brothers had long been straining to bolt.

ja.t: したくてうずうずしていた。

units.source_zh: 况且，池田兄弟早就撒腿欲奔。

units.source_en: Jō Izumi-no-kami arrived at just the right moment, and the horses broke free of their reins.
units.source_zh: 城和泉守适时赶来，马遂脱缰而去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 压抑已久的马群，只要有一匹率先冲出，其余的自会拼命跟上。况且，池田兄弟早就撒腿欲奔。城和泉守适时赶来，马遂脱缰而去。

paragraphs.source_en: Tadatsugu's and Katō's forces landed on Nakanoshima and spread the flames of battle across the entire island before dawn. It was the morning of the seventh.

units.source_en: Tadatsugu's and Katō's forces landed on Nakanoshima and spread the flames of battle across the entire island before dawn. It was the morning of the seventh.
units.source_zh: 忠继部与加藤部登上中之岛，在黎明之前让战火燃遍了全岛，此为初七清晨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠继部与加藤部登上中之岛，在黎明之前让战火燃遍了全岛，此为初七清晨。

paragraphs.source_en: As far as the eye could see, Ikeda Tadatsugu's standards streamed in the wind downstream, while Katō Akinari's standards snapped above the river; both forces hurled themselves ferociously upon Oda Uraku's troops.

units.source_en: As far as the eye could see, Ikeda Tadatsugu's standards streamed in the wind downstream, while Katō Akinari's standards snapped above the river; both forces hurled themselves ferociously upon Oda Uraku's troops.
units.source_zh: 放眼望去，池田忠继的马印在下游迎风招展，加藤明成的马印则在河上飒飒飘扬，二部恶狠狠向织田有乐部猛扑过去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 放眼望去，池田忠继的马印在下游迎风招展，加藤明成的马印则在河上飒飒飘扬，二部恶狠狠向织田有乐部猛扑过去。

paragraphs.source_en: At this, no one could restrain himself any longer. The first to leap aboard a boat was Togawa Higo-no-kami Michiyasu, lord of the thirty-nine-thousand-koku domain of Niwase in Bitchū, whose camp stood alongside Ikeda Toshitaka's. Next, Mori Mino-no-kami Tadamasa, lord of the one-hundred-and-eighty-six-thousand-koku domain of Tsuyama in Mimasaka, who was encamped near Katō, began crossing the river.

units.source_en: At this, no one could restrain himself any longer.

ja.t: もじっとしてはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 如此一来，众人都按捺不住了。

units.source_en: The first to leap aboard a boat was Togawa Higo-no-kami Michiyasu, lord of the thirty-nine-thousand-koku domain of Niwase in Bitchū, whose camp stood alongside Ikeda Toshitaka's. Next, Mori Mino-no-kami Tadamasa, lord of the one-hundred-and-eighty-six-thousand-koku domain of Tsuyama in Mimasaka, who was encamped near Katō, began crossing the river.
units.source_zh: 最先跳上船只的，乃是与池田利隆并行扎营的备中庭濑三万九千石的户川肥后守达安，接着，离加藤甚近的作州津山十八万六千石的森美浓守忠政开始渡河。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如此一来，众人都按捺不住了。最先跳上船只的，乃是与池田利隆并行扎营的备中庭濑三万九千石的户川肥后守达安，接着，离加藤甚近的作州津山十八万六千石的森美浓守忠政开始渡河。

paragraphs.source_en: Ikeda Toshitaka's Himeji force also began its river assault shortly after daybreak. The troops of Arima Genba-no-kami Toyouji, lord of the eighty-thousand-koku domain of Fukuchiyama in Tanba, saw that their allies had already seized Nakanoshima and pressed a step farther, crossing the river directly and surging toward Mount Tenma.

units.source_en: Ikeda Toshitaka's Himeji force also began its river assault shortly after daybreak. The troops of Arima Genba-no-kami Toyouji, lord of the eighty-thousand-koku domain of Fukuchiyama in Tanba, saw that their allies had already seized Nakanoshima and pressed a step farther, crossing the river directly and surging toward Mount Tenma.
units.source_zh: 姬路的池田利隆部亦在天亮未久就发起了渡河战，丹波福知山八万石的有马玄蕃头丰氏的部队，发现中之岛已经被自己人抢先占领，更是进了一大步，径直渡河向天满山方向扑去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 姬路的池田利隆部亦在天亮未久就发起了渡河战，丹波福知山八万石的有马玄蕃头丰氏的部队，发现中之岛已经被自己人抢先占领，更是进了一大步，径直渡河向天满山方向扑去。

paragraphs.source_en: Kagayama Kozaemon's prediction had come entirely true. If only a small force crossed, Uraku's army would still possess an overwhelming advantage in numbers; but once the armies along the whole line began moving one after another, nothing could stop them. Caught between Katō's force attacking from upstream and the Ikeda force led by Arā Tajima, Uraku's troops showed ever clearer signs of collapse. Apart from the Katō and Ikeda forces, the dark masses bearing down across the river were all enemies.

units.source_en: Kagayama Kozaemon's prediction had come entirely true.
units.source_zh: 加贺山小左卫门的预想完全变成了现实。

units.source_en: If only a small force crossed, Uraku's army would still possess an overwhelming advantage in numbers; but once the armies along the whole line began moving one after another, nothing could stop them.
units.source_zh: 若只是小股部队渡河，有乐军于人数上还占有巨大优势，可一旦诸路军队持续行动起来，必势不可挡。

units.source_en: Caught between Katō's force attacking from upstream and the Ikeda force led by Arā Tajima, Uraku's troops showed ever clearer signs of collapse.
units.source_zh: 在从上游杀过来的加藤部和以荒尾但马为首的池田部的夹攻下，有乐部败相频露。

units.source_en: Apart from the Katō and Ikeda forces, the dark masses bearing down across the river were all enemies.
units.source_zh: 除了加藤、池田二部，河面上黑压压杀来的，全是敌人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 加贺山小左卫门的预想完全变成了现实。若只是小股部队渡河，有乐军于人数上还占有巨大优势，可一旦诸路军队持续行动起来，必势不可挡。在从上游杀过来的加藤部和以荒尾但马为首的池田部的夹攻下，有乐部败相频露。除了加藤、池田二部，河面上黑压压杀来的，全是敌人。

paragraphs.source_en: When the feeble sunlight was once more veiled by cloud and mist, and the frostbound earth grew damp with fog, Uraku's force had already broken and fled toward Mount Tenma.

units.source_en: When the feeble sunlight was once more veiled by cloud and mist, and the frostbound earth grew damp with fog, Uraku's force had already broken and fled toward Mount Tenma.
units.source_zh: 当微弱的阳光再次被云雾遮住，冰霜的大地被雾气濡湿时，有乐部已往天满山方向溃逃。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当微弱的阳光再次被云雾遮住，冰霜的大地被雾气濡湿时，有乐部已往天满山方向溃逃。

paragraphs.source_en: Oda Urakusai ground his teeth in fury. To think he had been deceived so easily by Ieyasu! Although he had received no definite confirmation, it had appeared that Ieyasu truly wished to avoid battle. By sending the Katagiri brothers to the northern front, Ieyasu must also have meant to resolve the matter through negotiation.

units.source_en: Oda Urakusai ground his teeth in fury. To think he had been deceived so easily by Ieyasu!
units.source_zh: 织田有乐斋恨得咬牙切齿，居然如此轻易就被家康骗了！

units.source_en: Although he had received no definite confirmation, it had appeared that Ieyasu truly wished to avoid battle.

ja.t: たわけではなかったが、

units.source_zh: 虽然他并未接到确信，但家康看来似真不愿一战。

units.source_en: By sending the Katagiri brothers to the northern front, Ieyasu must also have meant to resolve the matter through negotiation.
units.source_zh: 把片桐兄弟派到北侧前线，家康一定也想通过谈判解决问题。

paragraphs.source_zh: 织田有乐斋恨得咬牙切齿，居然如此轻易就被家康骗了！虽然他并未接到确信，但家康看来似真不愿一战。把片桐兄弟派到北侧前线，家康一定也想通过谈判解决问题。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, Uraku's judgment was by no means groundless. Yet after suffering an unexpected night attack, he naturally seethed with inexpressible anger. “That old fox is past seventy, yet he still resorts to the tricks of a reckless young hothead. What a warmonger he is.”

units.source_en: In truth, Uraku's judgment was by no means groundless.
units.source_zh: 其实，有乐的这种判断绝非胡思乱想。

units.source_en: Yet after suffering an unexpected night attack, he naturally seethed with inexpressible anger. “That old fox is past seventy, yet he still resorts to the tricks of a reckless young hothead. What a warmonger he is.”
units.source_zh: 可是，在遭受意想不到的夜袭之后，他自然窝了一肚子说不出来的火气，“那老狐狸，都七十多了，还玩愣头小子的手段，真是个好战之人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，有乐的这种判断绝非胡思乱想。可是，在遭受意想不到的夜袭之后，他自然窝了一肚子说不出来的火气，“那老狐狸，都七十多了，还玩愣头小子的手段，真是个好战之人。”

paragraphs.source_en: Uraku himself was already sixty-eight years old. Seething with resentment, he gathered the remnants of his force and withdrew to Tenma, by which time he was utterly exhausted. Just then, however, eight hundred troops under Arima Genba swarmed toward him in boats. Uraku hastily ordered his panic-stricken men into the breastworks to steady their position. Even then he dared not relax his guard. Looking back, he saw Nakanoshima filled with the standards of Ikeda Tadatsugu and Katō Akinari.

units.source_en: Uraku himself was already sixty-eight years old. Seething with resentment, he gathered the remnants of his force and withdrew to Tenma, by which time he was utterly exhausted.

ja.t: いたころには、すっかり

units.source_zh: 愤愤不平的有乐也已是六十八岁高龄了，当他收拾残兵退至天满时，早已累得精疲力竭。

units.source_en: Just then, however, eight hundred troops under Arima Genba swarmed toward him in boats. Uraku hastily ordered his panic-stricken men into the breastworks to steady their position.
units.source_zh: 然而就在此时，有马玄蕃的八百军兵驾船一窝蜂拥了上来，有乐赶紧让慌作一团的士众钻进护垒，以稳住阵脚。

units.source_en: Even then he dared not relax his guard. Looking back, he saw Nakanoshima filled with the standards of Ikeda Tadatsugu and Katō Akinari.
units.source_zh: 但就算这样，仍是不敢大意，回首望去，中之岛已被池田忠继和加藤明成的马印填满。

paragraphs.source_zh: 愤愤不平的有乐也已是六十八岁高龄了，当他收拾残兵退至天满时，早已累得精疲力竭。然而就在此时，有马玄蕃的八百军兵驾船一窝蜂拥了上来，有乐赶紧让慌作一团的士众钻进护垒，以稳住阵脚。但就算这样，仍是不敢大意，回首望去，中之岛已被池田忠继和加藤明成的马印填满。

paragraphs.source_en: “Someone! We have suffered a night attack. Hurry into the castle and report the course of the battle.”

units.source_en: “Someone! We have suffered a night attack. Hurry into the castle and report the course of the battle.”
units.source_zh: “来人，我部遭夜袭，赶紧进城把战况禀报上去。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “来人，我部遭夜袭，赶紧进城把战况禀报上去。”

paragraphs.source_en: Not long after the still-unproven Yoshino Sanshirō departed, Urakusai, steam rising from his brow, advanced to meet Arima's force, which had just come ashore. He had held no hope of victory from the outset and naturally could not defeat attackers whose morale was soaring.

units.source_en: Not long after the still-unproven Yoshino Sanshirō departed, Urakusai, steam rising from his brow, advanced to meet Arima's force, which had just come ashore.
units.source_zh: 能力尚值得怀疑的芳野三四郎去了未久，有乐斋脑门上冒着热气，向刚刚上岸的有马部迎了上去。

units.source_en: He had held no hope of victory from the outset and naturally could not defeat attackers whose morale was soaring.
units.source_zh: 他一开始就未抱胜望，自然无法战胜士气正高的进攻一方。

paragraphs.source_zh: 能力尚值得怀疑的芳野三四郎去了未久，有乐斋脑门上冒着热气，向刚刚上岸的有马部迎了上去。他一开始就未抱胜望，自然无法战胜士气正高的进攻一方。

paragraphs.source_en: Yoshino, who did not even know what Ōno Harunaga looked like, wandered in confusion among the various positions inside the castle. When Urakusai saw Miyajima Bitchū's soldiers overwhelmed like an avalanche by the Fukushima and Ikeda forces, he had no choice but to order his men to set fire to the breastworks, then flee hurriedly into the castle.

units.source_en: Yoshino, who did not even know what Ōno Harunaga looked like, wandered in confusion among the various positions inside the castle. When Urakusai saw Miyajima Bitchū's soldiers overwhelmed like an avalanche by the Fukushima and Ikeda forces, he had no choice but to order his men to set fire to the breastworks, then flee hurriedly into the castle.
units.source_zh: 那个不知大野治长是何模样的芳野，在城内各阵中迷乱徘徊，有乐斋看到宫岛备中的士兵被如雪崩般的福岛和池田部袭击，只好急令士众放火烧了护垒，随后匆匆逃进城内。

paragraphs.source_zh: 那个不知大野治长是何模样的芳野，在城内各阵中迷乱徘徊，有乐斋看到宫岛备中的士兵被如雪崩般的福岛和池田部袭击，只好急令士众放火烧了护垒，随后匆匆逃进城内。

paragraphs.source_en: The officers and men remained in high spirits, coming one after another to report their achievements and ask for battle. “When will the general assault begin?”

units.source_en: The officers and men remained in high spirits, coming one after another to report their achievements and ask for battle. “When will the general assault begin?”
units.source_zh: 将士们仍意气昂扬，陆续前来报功、求战：“何时发动总攻？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 将士们仍意气昂扬，陆续前来报功、求战：“何时发动总攻？”

paragraphs.source_en: In fact, since ancient times armies had observed an unwritten custom permitting warriors to vie for glory. Thus, the Katō and Ikeda forces' early attacks could not be considered violations of military orders. The foremost honor went to Ikeda Tadatsugu, whose main force had seized Nakanoshima in a single stroke.

units.source_en: In fact, since ancient times armies had observed an unwritten custom permitting warriors to vie for glory.
units.source_zh: 事实上，自古以来，军中就有一个不成文的旧例——允许争功。

units.source_en: Thus, the Katō and Ikeda forces' early attacks could not be considered violations of military orders.
units.source_zh: 因此，加藤、池田各部率先出击，并不能算作违背军令。

units.source_en: The foremost honor went to Ikeda Tadatsugu, whose main force had seized Nakanoshima in a single stroke.
units.source_zh: 立头等战功的，就是一举占领中之岛的主力池田忠继。

paragraphs.source_zh: 事实上，自古以来，军中就有一个不成文的旧例——允许争功。因此，加藤、池田各部率先出击，并不能算作违背军令。立头等战功的，就是一举占领中之岛的主力池田忠继。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, should they not be commended?”

units.source_en: “My lord, should they not be commended?”

ja.t: めになるべきではございませんか」

units.source_zh: “大人，是不是该褒奖他们？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人，是不是该褒奖他们？”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu remained silent for a long time in response to Masazumi's suggestion. “Masazumi, it seems you do not understand what is in my heart.”

units.source_en: Ieyasu remained silent for a long time in response to Masazumi's suggestion.
units.source_zh: 对于正纯的建议，家康许久不答。

units.source_en: “Masazumi, it seems you do not understand what is in my heart.”

ja.t: かっておらぬようだな」

units.source_zh: “正纯，你似不明我的心思啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于正纯的建议，家康许久不答。“正纯，你似不明我的心思啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: In Ieyasu's speech, “Lord Kōzuke” and “Masazumi” carried very different implications. Masazumi's heart jolted. “Have I committed some fault?”

units.source_en: In Ieyasu's speech, “Lord Kōzuke” and “Masazumi” carried very different implications.
units.source_zh: 家康口中，“上野大人”和“正纯”意味大不一样。

units.source_en: Masazumi's heart jolted. “Have I committed some fault?”
units.source_zh: 正纯心下一惊，“是不是在下犯了什么过失？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康口中，“上野大人”和“正纯”意味大不一样。正纯心下一惊，“是不是在下犯了什么过失？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No, it is not a fault... not a fault.” Ieyasu shook his head. “But just as eating only until one is eight-tenths full preserves one's health, eight-tenths of a victory is enough.”

units.source_en: “No, it is not a fault... not a fault.”
units.source_zh: “唉，非是过失……非是过失。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu shook his head. “But just as eating only until one is eight-tenths full preserves one's health, eight-tenths of a victory is enough.”
units.source_zh: 家康摇了摇头，“但，正如‘饭吃八分饱’于养生一般，胜亦只八分足矣。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉，非是过失……非是过失。”家康摇了摇头，“但，正如‘饭吃八分饱’于养生一般，胜亦只八分足矣。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Eight-tenths?”

units.source_en: “Eight-tenths?”
units.source_zh: “八分？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “八分？”
